Ipilimumab (USAN, rINN) Ipilimumabum; MDX-010; MDX-CTLA-4. Immunoglobulin G1, anti-(human CTLA-4 (antigen)) (human γ1-chain), disulfide with human κ-chain, dimer. Ипилимумаб CAS — 477202-00-9. Profile Ipilimumab is an antibody to the cytotoxic-T-lymphocyte-asso- ciated antigen 4 (CTLA-4), which is a cell surface receptor in- volved in the downregulation of T-cell activation. Ipilimumab is under investigation for the treatment of melanoma and various solid tumours. Adverse effects include enterocolitis, hypophysi- tis, dermatitis, arthritis, uveitis, hepatitis, nephritis, and aseptic meningitis. ◊ References. 1. Beck KE, et al.
